coverage_decision: All main-text figures/tables and both supplied appendices were reconciled; pure bibliography was excluded from ATOM extraction and extracted separately as references Markdown.
source_consistency_flags: The protocol registry is printed as “PRESPRO” rather than the usual registry spelling; preserved without correction in source notes.
The study-selection sentence around <300-participant trials and phase 2/3 wording is syntactically ambiguous; no phase-based exclusion was inferred.
Appendix B §6.2 says “symptomatic hypertension” while the main article and forest plot label the outcome symptomatic hypotension.
Appendix B §7.2 cross-references Figure 5 for results from the HFpEF-exclusion sensitivity analysis although the supplement captions identify Figures 6–7 for that analysis.
Appendix B Figure 7 hyperkalemia panel duplicates the AKI rows and pooled OR 0.67 (0.36–1.25), while the narrative omits a hyperkalemia sensitivity result.
